assumptions.statement: The current use case is bounded indoor local-waypoint research, not an approved deployment mission.
The Genesis 13-link/27-shape envelope is historical simulated evidence, not a validated physical or ROS/Gazebo collision envelope.
Current maze objects are fixed ground, wall boxes, and landmark boxes without consequence-complete material, mass, fragility, person, safety-critical, or damage metadata.
The historical calf-link/Plane exclusion applies to the complete collapsed calf link and is not reinterpreted as foot-sphere-only support.
Perfect sensing supplies occurrence and attribution but not severity, acceptable consequence, recovery, stopping, ODD, or mission requirements.
Available reverse, yaw, hold, or curriculum behavior does not establish effective recovery, self-righting, stopping parity, or operator handoff.

unresolved_evidence.decision_affected: deployment contact scope and task-performance requirements
unresolved_evidence.needed: approved search or inspection application, ODD, human presence, asset classes, supervision, and mission consequences

unresolved_evidence.decision_affected: hard separation versus unresolved object context
unresolved_evidence.needed: object material, mass, mobility, fragility, safety criticality, person/proxy, permission, prohibition, and damage metadata
approved component/object force or validated substitute, impulse, speed, duration, repetition, penetration, stability, entrapment, and damage limits
Genesis, ROS/Gazebo, payload, and physical Go2 collision-envelope reconciliation
physical contact instrumentation and Genesis force/impulse calibration or a validated alternative
platform-equivalent stopping mode, request/acknowledgement latency, stopping distributions, and uncertainty margin

stakeholder-approved progress, coverage, revisit, inspection completeness, deadline, and missed-hazard consequence
formal hazard log, requirement ownership/allocation, acceptance criteria, verification independence, and SACE/AMLAS argument review
